messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Alert: GPU pool "eu-west-1-gpu-optim" queue length > 90th pct for 6m. autoscaler stayed at 16 replicas, scale-up attempts failing. Throttle rate on inference-tier rising. PagerBot: paging Jordan (oncall).
Jordan: ack, I'm on it. seeing paged alerts + customer error spikes in the dashboard. starting timeline.
Mei: jumping in to look at autoscaler logs and continuous-batching metrics.
Santiago: quick FYI — we pushed a config change to continuous_batch_min_size and autoscaler heartbeats last night in canary. Could be related.
Jordan: noted. Mei, can you paste the last 10 autoscaler events? I want to see why it didn't scale.
Mei: tail from controller-manager shows repeated "no scale action: heartbeat stale" around 15:42 UTC. snippet:
```
2026-03-14T15:41:58Z autoscaler controller reconcile: pool=eu-west-1-gpu-optim desired=40 observed=16 reason="heartbeat-missed"
2026-03-14T15:42:12Z autoscaler: scale suppressed: last_heartbeat=2026-03-14T15:30:05Z
```
Mei: also seeing continuous_batch_window jumped to 200ms during rollout (should be 80ms). That increased per-node batching, which reduced parallelism and amplified queueing.
Priya: so two factors: (1) autoscaler heartbeat suppression (no new replicas added) (2) batching param drift reducing throughput per GPU.
Santiago: plus prefix cache hitrate dropped from 94% to 33% after the same rollout — more cache misses increasing token work per request.
Alex: I'm here, infra. If autoscaler heartbeat is stale we might have a controller-side race or leader-election flake. Any leader logs? Could be controller draining for upgrade.
Jordan: immediate mitigation plan: 1) bump pool replicas manually to relieve queue, 2) temporarily rollback continuous_batch_window change, 3) disable prefix cache for this pool to avoid wasteful cache misses, 4) investigate heartbeat root cause offline.
Priya: agree. Manual scale first. Jordan, can you run the admin API to set desired_replicas=40? If not, I'll do it.
Jordan: running now:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://control-plane.internal/api/pools/eu-west-1-gpu-optim/scale -d '{"desired_replicas":40}'
```
Jordan: API returned 202 accepted. K8s shows new pods starting, but scheduling queue shows some pending due to AZ quota in eu-west-1a. Alex can you check capacity/quotas?
Alex: confirming, AZ eu-west-1a hit soft quota for G4s. I triggered placement into 1b/1c and pulled 10 spare GPUs from dedicated reserve. Pods now scheduling.
Mei: while nodes come up, rolling back batching param so in-flight requests don't inflate per-GPU latency. Applying config patch:
```
PATCH /config/pools/eu-west-1-gpu-optim
{ "continuous_batch_window_ms": 80 }
```
Mei: patch applied, pushing new runtime config. Rolling restart of router workers scheduled to pick up new batching behavior.
Santiago: disabling prefix cache for that pool now to short-circuit KV misses causing extra work:
```
PATCH /config/pools/eu-west-1-gpu-optim
{ "prefix_cache_enabled": false }
```
Santiago: done. Hitrate is irrelevant while it's off but we should see CPU/GPU cycles drop per request.
Jordan: customer impact summary for on-call notes: affected endpoints: /v1/generate for models rw-7b, rw-13b-quant; impacted customers ~12 orgs with sustained 5xx increase and elevated p95 latency. Observed error rate peaked at ~9% for the pool, now down to 3% after scale-up kicked.
Priya: marking Sev2 (partial degradation). Pager: send initial incident notification to customer-ops with ETA for mitigation ~15-20m.
Jordan: sending msg to customer-ops channel now: "Mitigating GPU pool saturation in eu-west. Manual scale + config rollback in progress; expected queue drain 10-25m. We'll follow up with RCA." :email:
IncidentBot: note added: runbook "gpu-pool-scale" invoked by Jordan at 15:45 UTC.
Mei: charts are showing queue length flattening, new replicas came online. throughput per-second increased ~1.8x after config rollback.
Santiago: logs show autoscaler leader election flapped during 15:30-15:40 due to controller heartbeat process crashing on a nil pointer in the new heartbeat code path. Suspect canary introduced a bug in heartbeat backoff.
Alex: created an infra incident to revert the heartbeat codepath in control-plane: PR #4211 to revert canary. Rolling back now.
Jordan: while rollback lands, keep the manual desired_replicas at 40 and set a temporary autoscaler override so the controller doesn't self-reduce.
Mei: doing that: setting override flag in pool metadata: "autoscale_override": "manual-40-until-16:30".
Priya: on customer comms — one enterprise report flagged 30 requests failing per minute for a specific route. Could be retry storms. Recommend we throttle retries client-side via gateway rules for the affected models until fully stable.
Santiago: added a transient rate-limit rule at edge for model rw-13b-quant: 500rps global. That will protect backend while queue drains.
Jordan: status update: pressure reduced, error rate now 1.2%, queue length trending down. Still monitoring. Next: RCA steps and postmortem owner?
Priya: I'll own postmortem with Santiago and Mei. Immediate RCA action items: revert heartbeat canary (Alex), add pre-deploy integration tests for autoscaler heartbeats, add guardrail for continuous_batch_window drift, and assert prefix_cache config can't be toggled without canary review.
Jordan: handing off to oncoming oncall @Alex for night overlap at 16:30 UTC. Alex, noted overrides and manual scale; I'll add runbook checklist to the thread.
Alex: ack takeover at 16:30. I'll watch for autoscaler behavior after full revert. If we see reoccurrence, escalate to platform lead.
IncidentBot: incident state changed -> mitigated (partial). Next update due in 2h for final close.
Jordan: adding quick timeline note to thread for postmortem: root cause = canary heartbeat regression + batching param drift + prefix cache misconfig -> compounded to overflow queue + blocked autoscale. Mitigation = manual scale, rollback batching window, disable prefix cache, revert heartbeat canary, add edge throttles.
Priya: thanks team. I'll draft customer-facing summary after we confirm error delta stabilized for 30m.
Alex: monitoring. If anything spikes, ping me with @alex and :pager:
Jordan: closing minimal handoff. Postmortem owners: Priya (lead), Santiago (metrics), Mei (runtime), Alex (infra revert). Will attach traces and dashboards to the PM. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:
